records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Maple Logistics!
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for setting up Maple Logistics on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone despite a welcome email [email:1dff2fd4] and a held onboarding call [calendar:5b658147]; no customer replies or tickets since. Silence after a live call suggests low momentum, though 8 days remain and the Pro plan shows intent.

draft.subject: Picking up where our call left off
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks again for the getting started call last week. I wanted to check in as you settle into Wrenfield.

If it's useful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. And whenever your team is ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
